text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Co-operative Societies (Modification of section 66 (1) in respect of NTUC Eldercare Co-operative Limited) Order 1998 and shall be deemed to have come into operation on 4th August 1998.

heading.en: Modification of section 66 (1) (g) of Act to donations

text.en: 2. Section 66 (1) (g) of the Act shall, in its application to the NTUC Eldercare Co-operative Limited, be modified to the extent that the building fund of NTUC Eldercare Co-operative Limited may be raised by donations from its members.
